title: In Seoul, Switching from Bus to Subway Is Free

slides.headline: In Seoul, the bus-to-subway switch **is free.**
slides.note: One card, one fare, as many changes as the trip needs.

slides.headline: One fare, **many rides**
slides.body: Tap a transit card (교통카드) and switch between buses and subway lines. The base fare, about ₩1,500, covers your first 10 km.

slides.headline: You pay for distance, **not rides**
slides.body: Past 10 km, about ₩100 more per 5 km. The meter counts the whole trip, not each vehicle.

slides.headline: Since **2004**
slides.body: Seoul rebuilt its bus network that year and tied buses and subway into one fare. Gyeonggi and Incheon joined later.

slides.headline: Don't forget to **tap out**
slides.body: Tap your card again when you get off the bus. Forget, and the next ride starts a new fare.

slides.headline: Nobody plans **around fares**
slides.body: Locals pick the fastest mix of bus and subway, not the cheapest. Three changes cost about the same as none.

slides.headline: No zones. **No paper tickets.**
slides.body: In many cities every ride is a new ticket. Here, one card and the system does the math.

slides.headline: To catch your next ride **for free**
slides.body: An hour late at night. Up to four transfers per trip.

slides.headline: Ride more. **Pay the same.**
slides.body: Korea prices public transit by the trip, not by the vehicle.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: Subway platform at night, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea's capital area, switching from bus to subway doesn't start a new fare.

One transit card tracks the whole trip, and you pay by distance, not by how many times you change.

How many tickets would the same trip take in your city?
reply: One more: the same transit card works on buses and subways in most Korean cities, and it pays for taxis and convenience store snacks too. Many people just use a credit card with the transit chip built in, so they never top anything up. How does your city charge you when you switch from bus to train?
fact_check: 2장: 서울 시내버스 1,500원(카드, 2023-08-12), 수도권 지하철 1,550원(2025-06-28 인상) — '약 ₩1,500' 표기. 기본거리 10km. 확인됨(한국경제·이투데이).
4장: 2004-07-01 서울 대중교통 체계 개편. 경기 2007-07, 인천 2009-10 합류. 확인됨(서울시 교통 누리집, 서울신문).
5장: 하차 미태그 시 환승 끊김 — 서울시 교통 안내.
8장: 하차 후 30분 이내(21:00~07:00 60분), 최대 4회 환승·5회 탑승 — 서울시 환승할인 안내.
댓글: 기후동행카드는 2026-08-31 종료·기후동행패스로 전환되어 뺐음. 교통카드 전국 호환·택시/편의점 결제·후불교통 신용카드로 교체.
